description: List the federal rules Tensorust models (ROAD Act investor ban, DoD SF 328 ownership disclosure, FCC foreign adversary attestation, Upper C-band elections, E-Rate deadlines) with counts and the first organizations each applies to. Pass rule_id for one rule (first 25 names, free); add full=true for the full named list with evidence with a Tensorust Radar or Ontology key.

full.description: With rule_id, true returns every organization the rule applies to, with evidence. Needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...). Omit for the first 25 names, free.

name: rule_coverage
title: Who a rule applies to
